text: Establish WTF Media as a governed, evidence-native podcast operating system: ISA is the acceptance and goal authority, GSD is the execution plan, and the public catalogue remains a protected projection. The approved plan preserves the brand while defining the provenance spine, operator-first information architecture, accessible components, phased workflows, integrations, and verification gates.
